integrity: Analytic proof of weighted-share conservation, exact affine mode, threshold trichotomy, inverse-time profile, global endemic selection and rank-one rigidity. Python standard-library checker supports but does not replace the infinite-time proof. Literature-priority residual risk noted; no external audit.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic additive-incidence Euler SIS map; positive rank-one common contacts, identical strain and homogeneous recovery parameters, physical-step restriction, and nonzero initial total required. Critical rate is infinite-time, not finite-population extinction-time. No assertion for unequal strains, higher-rank contacts, or independent stochastic transmissions.
title: Exact neutral-strain inheritance and its rank-one rigidity in discrete network epidemics
